description:
Perform a spatial intersection between rivers and countries in gvSIG Desktop.

Starting with a fresh gvSIG project, you need to:
1. Open a new View.
2. Add the following two shapefiles as layers:
   - Countries: /home/ga/gvsig_data/countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp
   - Rivers: /home/ga/gvsig_data/rivers/ne_110m_rivers_lake_centerlines.shp
3. Open the Geoprocessing toolbox (System toolbox).
4. Locate and run the 'Intersection' tool (Overlay > Intersection).
5. Configure the tool:
   - Input layer: Rivers (ne_110m_rivers_lake_centerlines)
   - Overlay layer: Countries (ne_110m_admin_0_countries)
6. Save the result shapefile to: /home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/rivers_by_country.shp

The resulting layer must contain river segments split by country boundaries, with attribute fields from BOTH input layers (e.g., river name AND country name).
